_note: The defined inventory an item is judged 'relevant' against. Mirrors the two autopatch-lab fixtures plus a couple of real-world frameworks, so Next.js/React-style real CVEs have something to be relevant or not relevant to.
note_on_react: react/react-dom are NOT in this inventory, so the react2shell typosquat item (i10) is correctly 'relevant: false' even though it is a real, scary-sounding supply-chain CVE: it never touches a real package we run.
note_on_vague_items: An item naming no package (e.g. i15, i30) can still be judged on topic-relevance (is this about npm security generally? about WordPress plugins generally?) when the extractor is asked for ecosystem+relevant without a specific package match.
